notes: Trolling involves deliberately causing harm or distress to others, relating to the care foundation (harm pole).

Tattle-tale relates to authority (reporting to authority figures); f***-the-police relates to defiance of authority and liberty (anti-oppressor sentiment); both poles touch loyalty (betrayal vs. anti-establishment solidarity).
Punk rock relates to defiance/rebellion (authority vice, liberty); preppy relates to conformity and tradition (authority virtue).
Factual relates to honesty, which maps to fairness; exaggerating implies dishonesty.
Attentive relates to care/nurturance; interrupting is inconsiderate of others.
Exhibitionism relates to purity foundation (modesty vs. immodesty; body as temple).
Envy relates to perceived unfairness in distribution; both envy and pride are traditionally considered moral vices (general).
Sexual vs. asexual relates to purity foundation (carnality, celibacy, abstention).
Clean maps to purity virtue; perverted maps to purity vice and general immorality.
